handover_report.prepared_for: Next AI engineering agent / continuation session

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

source_of_truth_before_this_work.status: Phase 7.6 Governance & Trust Visibility complete and fully validated

roadmap_item_addressed.immediate_priority: Connect selected AI provider to planning/suggestion generation

implemented_work.summary: Added createConfiguredPlanningAnswer(), reusing the configured provider runtime already used for chat/insights. The planning prompt requests strict JSON-only safe organization suggestions and preserves remote-provider policy checks.

Added generateConfiguredPreviewSuggestions(), which supports deterministic, provider, and hybrid planning modes. Provider output is JSON-parsed, sanitized, constrained to allowed action types, normalized to safe values, and falls back to deterministic suggestions if provider execution fails or returns invalid output.

Added provider-aware planning-session execution while preserving the original deterministic runPlanningSession() compatibility path. Current main contains runConfiguredPlanningSession() for provider/hybrid sessions.
The POST /suggestions route now calls generateConfiguredPreviewSuggestions() asynchronously and accepts optional mode/provider fields, defaulting to hybrid.
The planning session run route dispatches provider/hybrid modes to runConfiguredPlanningSession() and deterministic mode to the original runPlanningSession().
Added regression coverage for provider planning sessions using a mocked local OpenAI-compatible provider via lmStudio settings.

safety_and_governance_invariants: No destructive action execution was added.
Provider output only creates reviewable suggestions; execution still requires the existing preview/execution flow.
Provider suggestions are normalized and constrained to tag, category, rename, and move.
Move suggestions are relative folder labels only, never absolute paths.
Rename suggestions are filenames only, never paths.
Provider failure or invalid JSON falls back to deterministic suggestions.
The deterministic generatePreviewSuggestions() function remains available for existing callers and tests.
Existing Phase 7.6 governance diagnostics and scoring logic were not changed.

validation_status.connector_limitation: The GitHub connector supports file inspection and commits but does not provide an npm execution environment. Validation must be run locally by the user.

known_risks_or_followups: Run the backend test suite first. The new test mocks globalThis.fetch and restores it in finally, but full suite validation is still required.
If provider planning tests fail, inspect services/api/test/planningSessions.test.js and services/api/src/ai/providerRuntime.js first.
After validation passes, update this handover or create a completion handover marking provider planning suggestions as validated.

The next roadmap item after this is backend planning-rule enforcement, but this implementation already begins applying planning rules inside configured suggestion generation. A dedicated enforcement milestone should still verify preview/execution blocking semantics separately.
next_approved_actions: Run npm run typecheck in apps/everything-ai-ui.
Run npm run build in apps/everything-ai-ui.
If all validation passes, mark the selected-provider planning/suggestion generation milestone as complete and proceed to backend planning-rule enforcement.
